criteria.title: Приёмка в браузере на стендах
criteria.how: steps 1, 2, 3, 4, 6 and 7 (given to RELEASE-VALIDATOR, own measurements) repeated; stands B (sample journal) and A (empty); clean profiles. Page clock fixed by replacing Date.now in the page only (+5 s and +61 min after the last event of the stand). Stand: an own Pixel Office server started with `node src/pixel-office/main.js --port 0 --dir <outside the project>/stand-…` and SAI_PIXEL_OFFICE_DIR set to the same folder; events written only through the real `src/pixel-office/hook.sh` (26 events: main session sample-1 with an owner request, 10 role runs, B launched by A, two ends, Stop) and one orchestrator record through `src/pixel-office/note.js`; the owner journal, its copies and the ports 4780, 4782, 4790 were not used. Browser: Google Chrome headless, a new profile per page, driven over the debugging protocol with real mouse and key events; Chrome and the stand were stopped by their process ids. Results: <outside the project>/uat/res/po1…po5.json, shots in <outside the project>/uat/res/shots/. Steps 5, 8 and the reader of step 9 by the records. Records of the run REQ050-20261017-01: docs/uat/REQ-050-051-052-053-RUN.md and docs/uat/REQ-05x-RUN.md, UAT 31 of 31 after repeat 2, BA-ANALYST signature handoffs/REQ050-20261017-01/step-08c-ba-analyst-r1.json (PASS).
criteria.evidence: Step 1 (1470, 1920): no tour, invitation «Впервые здесь? Покажу за минуту, что где.», header 60 px, invitation inside the window and crossing none of #now, office, journal, tasks; focus not on it; #now 382 px and 832 px wide (≥ 10 rem), 8 rows not cut, no broken word; «Показать» — «Шаг 1 из 6», «Это Pixel Office», no highlight. Step 2 (1470, 1920, both moments): step 1 centred (offset 0); steps 2–6 highlight office, «Сейчас», journal, «Задачи», «Как пользоваться»; T and E never cross, gap 12–19.5 px (≤ 24); T inside the window; elementFromPoint at the centre of E is E. Step 3: at step 4 a new hook event — rows 26 → 27, tour at step 4; «Работа» — filter on, step 4; card over the tour, Escape — card closed, step 4. Step 4: Escape with the focus in the tour — closed, focus «Как пользоваться»; reload — no invitation, no tour. Step 6 (390, 320, both moments): invitation inside, no scroll aside; header growth with the invitation 21 px and 6 px (≤ 80); the tour sheet bottom = innerHeight, left 0, width = innerWidth; every tour button 36 px high = #pause, × 36 px wide (= 2.25 rem); E.top < T.top on steps 2–6; but E.top is −0.109 px (390×844, +61 min, steps 2 and 6) and −0.219 px (320×568, +61 min, steps 2 and 6), while the criterion asks E.top ≥ 0 without a tolerance. Step 7 (stand A): step 2 without highlight, «Это офис. Сейчас в нём никого. …»; step 3 highlights «Сейчас», «Здесь — кто занят прямо сейчас: …»; step 4 highlights the journal, «Это журнал. Событий пока нет. …».
